programme.desc: 佐敦与丽闹翻，亨回印度的事不了了之。亨向丽勒索，更令人误会二人拍拖。丽向亨表示凡知道她富有的人三日内必定会意外死去，亨接连遇上怪事，往找丽求救。丽道出唯有说服其他人相信这个秘密，从而将诅咒转移给那人。

programme.title: 天龙八部#26粤普PG
programme.desc: 虚竹回少林寺，灵鹫宫四姑娘暗中跟随。哲罗星与清凉寺方丈来到少林寺，要求少林寺释放波罗星。少林寺则指波罗星偷学少林武功。期间鸠摩智前来挑战少林众长老，虚竹见状还击，却暴露了自己身上的逍遥派武功…

programme.title: 交易现场粤 及 潮流生活志粤
阿爷厨房粤
programme.desc: 鼎爷、阿谭一试压制虾膏，兼以大澳出产的靓虾酱蒸煮猪板筋，以烈酒腌猪肉有何作用？食材摆放次序原来足以影响菜式质素；再用虾膏带来「虾酱啫啫生菜」，简单易做。主持们在南海盐步搜罗各式茄子，见识特产秋茄的种植过程。二人制作「茹香茄子」迎合绿色星期一，以腐乳代替咸鱼，不失原材料的精髓，色香味俱全！另一道「清炒素五子」够健康，为何果仁需分开汆水？新鲜雪耳属时令食材，但无有怕，选用干雪耳亦可炒出鲜味。

programme.title: 流行都市粤
programme.desc: 女性于更年期后因雌激素下降，患心血管疾病的风险大增。心脏科医生指男女的心脏病发的症状大有分别，女士如出现上背痛、上腹痛便要提高警觉。通波仔手术是心脏病的主流治疗，部份女患者却未必适合，有何原因？区瑞强、周国丰、郑子诚三位资深DJ将首次合作开骚，他们惺惺相惜，私下情谊深厚。国丰笑言担心唱歌时忘记歌词；子诚亦坦言对唱歌感忧虑，并感谢区瑞强的窝心支援。「睇𩠌食饭」，Annie师傅示范「鱼香茄子肉碎」。

programme.title: 一条麻甩在东莞粤
programme.desc: 有没有一家店可一次过品尝东莞各地区的美食？在万江区，本集探店的这家酒楼就可以满足你，不仅如此，内里还附设一个甚具规模的东莞饮食风俗博物馆！大饱口福之后，祖蓝还带大家去「料」(玩)，行逛一个历史文化古村— 下坝坊，这里并不简单，游人于白天可以感受百年古镇的风情，夜晚就大变身，成为年轻人最爱「蒲」之地……

programme.title: 灿烂的外母#5粤
programme.desc: 兆明请员工吃蛋挞，威龙替他说好话，秀琼诧异。兆明约司徒岚参加莎莎舞之夜；窦彰亦答应德正一同参加莎莎舞活动。司徒岚在舞会忽见秀琼出现，她要兆明回避。德正与柯美娜跳舞期间见到秀琼，即找兆明掩饰。六人同坐一桌，司徒岚苦思如何收拾残局。秀琼前往拜祭亡夫，司徒岚要秀琼忆述父亲救人牺牲经过。俊男向司徒岚送花示爱，司徒岚表示已有男朋友，窦彰误会司徒岚认定自己是其男友。威龙等车时见到晓盈喝醉，邓勤送她回家……

programme.title: 偶像星愿7 Third BEAT!粤日
programme.desc: 万理忆述自己与千相识并组织乐队的经过，因为多次与其他成员发生冲突，万理劝千放弃自己演奏，改为专心唱歌和加入舞蹈，令Re:vale获得成功。当时的百随姊姊去看Re:vale的演唱会，瞬间深受感动。

programme.title: Hands Up粤
programme.desc: 菠萝油是香港代表食品之一，子健哥哥从其香脆可口的外皮动笔，示范怎样画出这款港式美食。此外，不少人还爱配以冻柠檬茶一并享用，组合成茶餐厅的经典套餐。本集「Artspiration」带领观众了解个中绘画技巧，其间Emily姐姐亦分享她制作面包的经历。小朋友投稿「我最爱的玩具」，有孩子绘画了铁道火车，勾起玲玲姐姐童年玩蒸汽火车模型的美好回忆。也有小朋友介绍自己的心爱毛公仔，主持姐姐亦忆述儿时的公仔玩伴。

programme.title: 秘密的偶像公主粤日
programme.desc: 千依突然要求加入Secret Friends，跟阳葵等人一起练习，但是，当她知道练习内容跟人气萤光幻彩变身没有关系，便立即宣布退出。千依对人气萤光幻彩变身这份执著，背后隐藏著的，正是她不为人知的过去。

programme.title: 财经新闻粤
programme.desc: 紧贴市况，逢交易日下午5时50分报道当日本港和外围股市行情，以及重点财经新闻。

programme.title: 利嘉阁地产45 周年真盘源特约：今日有楼睇粤 及 潮流生活志粤
programme.desc: 宝林一个居屋三房单位，设计利用大地色系，营造温馨感觉，最终效果如何？

programme.title: 六点半新闻报道粤
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六点半，报道本地、两岸及国际重要新闻。

programme.title: 世界观粤 及 天气报告粤
东张西望粤
programme.desc: 几区夹公仔店的监控片段，都拍到两人团伙毫不掩饰样貌公然爆窃，十分猖獗。中环某天桥楼梯长期被外佣霸占，还化身为山寨美容院，更疑似以低价为其他外佣提供按摩、修甲等服务？除了中环外，荃湾亦有类似情况？大律师指出涉事者或已违反在港逗留条件，还有阻街、妨扰罪行。陈豪、陈贝儿、谭俊彦等星级艺员出席TVB推广营销平台发布会，并分享理财投资心得。另带来有助摆脱湿敏困扰的相关资讯。

programme.title: 黄道益活络油呈献：爱． 回家之开心速递#2763粤
programme.desc: 壮、Elaine与Venus被力莲抽中，负责筹办春茗。壮与Venus本想偷懒，打算沿用往年流程，Elaine却用心构思新项目，获力莲赞赏；因Elaine过于投入，壮与Venus亦被迫加倍努力，因此疲于奔命。壮尝试劝Elaine不要太落力，却不果。Venus暗中「搞破坏」，Elaine意外识破此事，并得知壮亦不认同自己……春茗当天，众人期待享用佳肴、抽获名贵礼品，以及欣赏巨星演出，但却大失所望……

programme.title: X Wallet呈献:卧底娇娃#15粤PG
programme.desc: 妙姿先宗南一步前往奕风家，处理了可证明奕风协助学年逃脱的物品。步青往找佳琪，请求她帮忙调查奕风。学年被踢出四联商会，刘彪重返四联，并接管车仔化工的业务。学年跟踪刘彪、索帕，发现奕风与索帕会面。学年绑走奕风，当得知奕风是助世豪对付刘彪，表示可提供协助。佳琪发现刘彪和丽荃的暧昧行径，终证实二人偷情。妙姿拿到嘉盈的电脑，找小茹帮忙解码；其后，电脑却出现在奕风手上……

programme.title: Funki Finance 呈献：机智女法医2#7粤普PG
programme.desc: 瑾瑜醉酒说心口疼，令楚楚想到什么，复验神观尸体后发现他是中毒而亡。景翊府中遭贼，冷月推测贼人是为花而来，众人分析后锁定森垚。景翊把森垚带到瑾瑜面前套话，森垚终说出是听从鬼差的话，给神观喝了下了药的茶。

programme.title: 中国建设银行(亚洲)呈献：攻你上大学粤
programme.desc: 中三考题开正《中年好声音》众人的「音乐专业」，有人豪言答错即引退！「褶曲作用」的地貌考起大家，文静老师更畀山埃贴士？中五公民与社会发展题，某君趣谈「软硬理论」，令Bob教授都难以招架！大学领域难度升级，「优异生」二话不说将滴定管题目送给对手。模仿有助解读接吻鱼行为？终极两强以物理学「重力奇异点」知识对决，被「钦点」答题者却分析得似层层，可望转危为机。音乐巨作成赢「奖学金」关卡，哼得出都未必识答……

programme.title: 娱乐头条粤 及 环球新闻档案粤
programme.desc: 节目主要以当日的娱乐新闻作重点，让你瞬间掌握影视娱乐圈动态和最新消息，并以「娱乐大事件」、「抢闸头条」、「出炉猛料」等为主题作头条新闻式报道。

programme.title: 晚间新闻粤
programme.desc: 报道本地、两岸、国际重要新闻以及体育消息，让你洞悉各地大事及体坛动向。

programme.title: 天气报告粤 及 潮流生活志粤
康业信贷快递呈献：寻秦记#23粤
programme.desc: 赵穆宴请董匡，突指他是冒牌货，少龙吓一跳。琴清与少龙在花园相遇，少龙放出捉来的萤火虫，无数萤火虫围著琴清飞舞令她惊叹。赵穆秘密去祭山鬼，少龙计划利用一线天的天险生擒赵穆。琴清邀少龙游湖画画，少龙灵机一动将琴清的水墨画改为彩墨画，琴清喜出望外。回程时琴清扭伤脚，由少龙抱回府。滕翼责少龙错过生擒赵穆的机会，少龙愧疚。琴清再约少龙游湖，却惊见赵穆出现，却被幪面黑衣人偷袭就擒，琴清扯下黑衣人面巾及假胡子。

programme.title: 粤讲粤㜺鬼粤
programme.desc: 压轴一集，大妈们在社区会堂跳着熟练舞步，对宠物、表演、食物相关歇后语又有多少认识？俗语「豆泥」源自糕点馅料；「苏虾仔」正写是「苏孲崽」，大学讲师廖舜禧逐一解构。三位主持和黄建东在怀旧士多「寻宝」，竟分别互称表兄妹，究竟搞边科？「摩罗街雨褛－ 过底」有何喻意？掌故专家郑宝鸿并讲解摩罗街叫摩罗街的原因。主持们走进果栏了解「发财丁」、「坐车」等行内术语；还向毛冷舖店主请教不同毛冷的质地及保存毛衣方法。

programme.title: 粤讲粤㜺鬼粤
programme.desc: 传统金器手工精巧，现代机器难以取代。主持人来到金舖欣赏各款名贵首饰，期间竟有人被称呼为「石狗公」，有何所指？花生糖保持古法人手炮制，昔日风味得以保存。麦美恩亲自拜师学习做糖，顺道细谈「石地板种花生」、「发霉花生」等歇后语。「老细」、「事头」何以成为上司代名词？且听中文讲师廖舜禧拆解。粤语逾二千年来原来甚少演变，故被视为古汉语「活化石」。廖舜禧追溯广府话历史，还从「锡」「勼」「冧」三字解构爱情真义！

programme.title: 香港早晨粤 及 环球新闻档案粤
隆行天下之重走八千里路云和月普
手匠传承粤韩
programme.desc: 本集将介绍沙特阿拉伯一种独特的编织工艺- 「阿尔萨度」贝都因人用阿尔萨度亲手为家庭制作所需的物品, 她们一边编织布料, 一边互相分享家人的消息, 阿尔萨度不只是织布技术, 更是一种团结家庭的集体艺术

programme.title: 翻生工程粤英
programme.desc: 工程师Rob Bell带大家探讨将废弃结构转变为未来建筑背后的重大挑战。

programme.title: 仨心友行粤
programme.desc: 敏之、凯琳正享用丰富早餐之际，高Ling忽然带同杨明神秘回归，为姊妹送上惊喜！走进地道市场，四人兵分两路，尽情选购特色小食、用品。敏之、凯琳化身「头巾西施」推销商品，反应理想！杨明、高Ling紧接接受挑战，更出动「美男计」兜售头巾，生意又怎样？一行人登船前往停泊岛，迎接阳光与海滩。当地度假村设有不同类型的酒店房间，三位美女藉小游戏分房期间却与制作团队发生冲突……杨明细看之下，竟察觉当中有蛊惑？

programme.title: 港产旅行团粤
programme.desc: Ben Sir带队，联同祖仪、衍峰向上水古洞村出发，来到村内硕果仅存的旧式茶楼，桌上碌鹅、酿鲮鱼等菜肴，品尝传统客家风味。三人紧接前往马草垄迎接醉人日落，捕捉靓人靓景，轻松完成打卡之旅！衍峰、邝洁楹随萧欣浩博士寻找旧香港足迹，畅游上环歌赋街，享用港式美食，霸王鸭、金钱鸡有何来头？颖彤、黄庭锋实试几款设备齐全的本地露营车，还可观星、煮饭仔，适合二人世界。

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷粤
programme.desc: 荷里活电影被誉为业界殿堂，其历史可追溯至一百多年前。滢仴简介最早期的默片，以及有声与彩色电影的诞生过程。上世纪约七十年代被指是传统与新荷里活电影的分水岭，二者有何不同？来到千禧年，电影走进数码时代，另一谷主凯婷觉得电脑合成影像(CG)是最大特色。滢仴引述「派拉蒙法案」案例，它是影响上世纪美国影业发展的重大事件。踏入廿一世纪，串流平台兴起，也导致影业的生态再有大转变。此外，据说电影彩蛋与复活节有关？

programme.title: 警声百二秒 III粤
programme.desc: 「警声百二秒」系列再次归来，《警声百二秒 III》由警方代表联同众多艺员参与演出，会继续透过有趣的故事情节，介绍香港警务处更多部门的工作、更多防罪讯息，让广大市民可轻松「全方位」了解警队更多资讯。

programme.title: 巴打秘景游粤
programme.desc: 置身远离繁嚣的荔枝窝，「巴打」在生态导师带领下夜探郊野，上一堂大自然生态课。预定到海岸边赏日出，陈浚霆却「唔知醒」，拍档们决定大整蛊！叹杯金针花茶后，三人初试下田施肥与耘田，有人「泥足深陷」，焦浩轩更把工具弄断？他们还获居民设宴招待，品尝家常客家菜。鸭洲可以找到罕见的褐红色沉积岩，「鸭颈」、「鸭眼」更是必到打卡点！紧接到访邻近小岛吉澳，巴打入乡随俗，体验钓鱼之余，也会学做客家茶粿，感受纯朴人情味。

programme.title: Gi味俱全粤
programme.desc: 东南亚食品向来深受香港人欢迎，本集Gigi姐就会教大家做一道充满东南亚风味的猪颈肉，而带出这种风味的秘诀在于磨碎了的柠檬叶、鱼露、青柠汁和辣椒粉。只要掌握上述窍门，就能很简单做出美味的猪颈肉。

programme.title: 好市民奖颁奖典礼2025粤
programme.desc: 「好巿民奖」旨在彰显好人好事，带动社会守望相助、携手扑灭罪行。2025年度颁奖典礼于2026年3月14日在会展举行，并由区永权、陈庭欣担任司仪，凝聚好市民、好机构的正能量。各个获奖单位为协助警方破案、拯救生命、推动防罪灭罪作杰出贡献，TVB直播嘉许情况。单立文、张驰豪、周志康、郑俊弘、罗毓仪藉歌声鼓励一众无名英雄；男团Hey Brother献唱之余，还与林秀怡合演小剧场，宣扬好市民精神与防骗讯息。

programme.title: Hands Up粤
programme.desc: 「WORKOUT 2GETHER」，这次两项训练都集中于下身，听从儿童体适能教练的指示来完成吧！跟随拍子做运动，提起一只脚上下移动的同时，分别将一只手以钟摆形式摆动，以及举高、放低双手，可有难度？站立式的「踏单车」动作，有助增强下肢肌力与协调度。轮到「臀部训练」，以不同姿势坐于瑜伽垫上，利用臀部发力做锻练，亦可顺道伸展腰部。双手带动身体向后仰的动作，既可伸展颈部与胸大肌，练习得多就更易做到拱桥？

programme.title: 查查林部队粤英
programme.desc: 森林里神秘怪事频生。巨大陷阱出现，栗子消失，昆虫失踪，橡实从天而降！要交由大侦探Peet和朋友Baba和Molly组成的查查林部队调查。牠们未必是最能干的侦探队，但往往能够迎刃而解，揭开大自然奥秘。

programme.title: 查查林部队粤英
programme.desc: 森林里神秘怪事频生。巨大陷阱出现，栗子消失，昆虫失踪，橡实从天而降！要交由大侦探Peet和朋友Baba和Molly组成的查查林部队调查。牠们未必是最能干的侦探队，但往往能够迎刃而解，揭开大自然奥秘。

programme.title: 樱桃小丸子粤日
programme.desc: 白色情人节将至，小丸子期盼丰厚回礼，冬田和小渚亦各自对心仪的男孩有所期待。小丸子从花轮口中得知古董的价值，于是偕同爷爷去逛废物市集，希望发掘到不为人知的宝物，借此发一笔横财。

programme.title: 潜行天下粤
programme.desc: 《潜行天下》以全球海洋为主题，采用8K超高清摄影机和水下无人机等技术建构沉浸式观影体验，跨越四大洋14国水域拍摄，记录双髻鲨、鲸鲨等海洋生物活动，探密三沙永乐龙洞等特殊地形。

programme.title: 六点半新闻报道粤
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六点半，报道本地、两岸及国际重要新闻。

programme.title: 新闻透视粤
programme.desc: 衞生署儿童体能智力测验中心，大约有七成新症在服务目标的6个月内完成评估，但部分个案声称要轮候年半至两年。轮候时间长，万一儿童错过六岁前的「黄金介入期」，对他们成长有多大影响呢？随著社会对特殊教育需要的认识和接受程度提升，预计怀疑个案会越来越多，政府可以如何加强服务，让这批小朋友及早获得评估及适切的治疗呢？

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粤
programme.desc: 香港特区政府带领各个部门及单位，适时推出不同的政策措施，为本港市民、到访旅客、来自外地的投资者提供便捷服务。香港这么好，当然要多说一些让大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以轻松有趣的拍摄手法，配合陈豪、高海宁、张振朗、刘佩玥、周嘉洛、罗子溢、马国明、陈懿德、陈展鹏、刘颖旋等一众星级艺员，透过不同角色、形象，生动地表达香港的各样美好和优势。

programme.title: 东张西望粤
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报道娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: K Cash业主私人贷款呈献 :香港系列之细间始终你好粤
programme.desc: 祥师兄所说全港最美味的墨鱼丸，是怎样制造的？粉面店第三代传人指重点是新鲜，猪肉丸亦是同样道理！店主偕同母亲传承祖传的味道，目标成为百年老店！婚礼摄影师锐意打造属于年轻人的新派旗袍，还提供化妆、摄影一条龙服务。祥师兄穿起店内唐装，再于街头拍照，大赞专业！湾仔一间小木屋其实是松饼小店，开店源于吃过英国松饼，但发觉在港难找到？小店也可发展为大公司，祥师兄走访本地个人护理用品厂房，CEO亦会细说经营理念。

programme.title: AlipayHK 呈献:唱钱粤
programme.desc: 音准、拍子大考验，唱歌随时有钱落袋！两孩之母Mani继续冲击第二条提款线，更剑指「魔王之歌」？每年自资到录音室录歌的歌唱爱好者亦会接受《唱钱》洗礼，透过挑战Sing盘上不同歌曲难度「过三关」，甚至是最难的Monster关卡，向扫清九宫格的目标进发。观众只需用手机扫描萤幕上的QR Code，即可参与直播室互动，为挑战者打气，更有机会赢取福利。

programme.title: J Music粤
programme.desc: 吴崇铭发觉布志纶作品<如是因 如是果与自己的<挂念你 你好吗构思相若，于是带来「一晚限定」的混唱合作，两人亦分别送上甜蜜情歌<一家之主与<贴地，志纶还有忠粉到场支持偶像。张驰豪新推出<一个人的生日歌，旨在为孤单人士送上力量。独立歌手Young Hysan唱出他的<道歉启示。冯熙燮细谈独立组合时期与现时成为签约歌手的大不同，并感谢T-Rexx将其心路历程，写进<聆听自己的声音歌词内。

programme.title: 风味人间 第2季粤
programme.desc: 蓝蟹是梭子蟹的分支，美国马里兰人爱蒸熟后撒上当地香料，味道咸香辛辣。日本厨师是拆蟹达人，能将香箱蟹拆肉后再拼回原只奉客。美国人则喜欢将蟹拆肉，混合面包糠、蛋黄酱等造蟹饼，酥香可口。螃蟹脱壳后，会暂时变为肉少的水蟹，澳门人看准其特性，煮成水蟹粥，鲜甜滋味。江苏一带会将蟛蜞捣碎过滤煮成「豆腐」，软滑鲜香。将生蟹加盐腌制的炝蟹，是浙江的地道美食。韩国人亦擅于将生蟹腌制进食，酱油蟹更被喻为「白饭小偷」。

programme.title: J Sport粤
programme.desc: 四位香港杰出学生运动员奖得主细谈感受与目标，又会如何平衡学业与体育？U18男子冰球世锦赛，港队在尾场挫新西兰，以四胜一负成绩摘亚。曼联旧将朗尼庄臣来港参与足球活动，与小朋友交流，并回望「红魔」岁月。甲一篮球总决赛第三场，满贯与香港东方争逐领先优势。王玮骏、陈钰文于维港赛艇赛夺双人双桨艇金牌；另检视香港田径系列赛男、女飞人冲线时刻。这集还带来学界足球精英赛两场准决赛战报、青少年棍网球公开赛记招花絮。

programme.title: 晚间新闻粤 及 天气报告粤
programme.desc: 报道本地、两岸、国际重要新闻以及体育消息，让你洞悉各地大事及体坛动向。

programme.title: 财经透视粤
programme.desc: 本地出生率持续创新低，但去年婴幼儿用品零售市场，反而逆市造好，为何会如此？中东局势紧张，一旦情况进一步恶化，对全球以至香港经济的影响多大？

programme.title: 叠影狙击#7粤PG
programme.desc: 诺召开记者会为公司丑闻致歉；晨到总公司履新，接到雄的来电。证物房起火，USB被烧毁，同时证人发亦被杀。KC以曦伪造文件的影片威胁晨助其加入总公司，结果反遭晨威胁。雄约晨见面，让晨在诺的办公室装监听器。

programme.title: 成人教科书粤
programme.desc: 香港近年成为全球最长寿地区，几位十岁出头的孩子又希望活到多少岁？在节目组和洪永城安排下，小朋友分成两组，第一组到学校，向校长及负责老师了解校内如何推行生死教育，并共同饲养一条「宠物鱼」。第二组前往山野接受求生技巧训练，掌握搭建帐篷后，一试野外捉鱼并随即动刀㓥鱼。活动尾声，两组人都有一条鱼作「食物报酬」，为何一边感到雀跃，另一边却愁云惨雾？养鱼组别当知道眼前蒸鱼并非所养的宠物鱼，心情和胃口大为转变！

programme.title: 手匠传承粤韩
programme.desc: 本集将介绍沙特阿拉伯一种独特的编织工艺- 「阿尔萨度」贝都因人用阿尔萨度亲手为家庭制作所需的物品, 她们一边编织布料, 一边互相分享家人的消息, 阿尔萨度不只是织布技术, 更是一种团结家庭的集体艺术

programme.title: 翻生工程粤英
programme.desc: 工程师Rob Bell带大家探讨将废弃结构转变为未来建筑背后的重大挑战。

programme.title: 隆行天下之重走八千里路云和月普
粤讲粤㜺鬼粤
programme.desc: 压轴一集，大妈们在社区会堂跳着熟练舞步，对宠物、表演、食物相关歇后语又有多少认识？俗语「豆泥」源自糕点馅料；「苏虾仔」正写是「苏孲崽」，大学讲师廖舜禧逐一解构。三位主持和黄建东在怀旧士多「寻宝」，竟分别互称表兄妹，究竟搞边科？「摩罗街雨褛－ 过底」有何喻意？掌故专家郑宝鸿并讲解摩罗街叫摩罗街的原因。主持们走进果栏了解「发财丁」、「坐车」等行内术语；还向毛冷舖店主请教不同毛冷的质地及保存毛衣方法。

programme.title: 粤讲粤㜺鬼粤
programme.desc: 传统金器手工精巧，现代机器难以取代。主持人来到金舖欣赏各款名贵首饰，期间竟有人被称呼为「石狗公」，有何所指？花生糖保持古法人手炮制，昔日风味得以保存。麦美恩亲自拜师学习做糖，顺道细谈「石地板种花生」、「发霉花生」等歇后语。「老细」、「事头」何以成为上司代名词？且听中文讲师廖舜禧拆解。粤语逾二千年来原来甚少演变，故被视为古汉语「活化石」。廖舜禧追溯广府话历史，还从「锡」「勼」「冧」三字解构爱情真义！

programme.title: 大玩特玩粤
programme.desc: 主持与十位艺员在购物城内疯狂玩乐！「吹杯过杯」只有连诗雅「食白果」，她在问答环节还要玩了半小时才知道「答问题要先举手」；相反，何君诚的表现令人喜出望外。众人斗快「不用手穿裤子」，黄美棋使出瑜伽动作、周志康化身人肉四驱车，怪招尽出。出线比赛坐飞毡赛跑，何雁诗被对手大幅抛离，幸好最后一棒是美棋对连诗雅，赛果可想而知！

programme.title: 熊猫一家人粤普
programme.desc: 各实习饲养员结束了康养区和繁育园的学习和工作，回到神树坪基地。这段时间，导师们见证了各实习生的成长过程，对他们的进步都感到满意。另一方面，为了教育园区游客关于熊猫的基础知识，实习生们举办了教育课堂。

programme.title: 星梦频道粤日
programme.desc: 绘萌、安娜、凛花的演唱会顺利结束了，宝石偶像等待著四眼姐姐公布接下来的顺序。但是，表演顺序还没出炉，玫儿就已经站上舞台，还开始进行演唱会。在玫儿促使下，其他宝石偶像也相继登上舞台。

programme.title: 星梦频道粤日
programme.desc: 钻石时装大赛进入最高潮，尚未登台的宝石偶像只剩虹之咲、未来、杏树三人。宝石时装大赛开办者虹之咲，奇迹闪耀组的中心人物未来，还有星梦频道偶像顶点的杏树，钻石偶像的宝座到底花落谁家!?

programme.title: 多啦A梦粤
programme.desc: 大雄见家里经济财政紧绌，于是走去寻宝，多啦A梦知道后借他「寻宝机」和「飘浮喷雾」。大雄不小心害静香的胸针掉进水塘，用过法宝「加醋减醋」后心生一计，但在前往水塘的路上遭遇诸多阻挠。

programme.title: B-PROJECT超星团粤日
programme.desc: 在翼的努力之下，Ultras的工作渐上轨道，但A太却因为一次误会而抱怨翼把B-PROJECT放在优先，本身对Ultras颇有微词的刚士因而与A太发生冲突，讵料此时公司却下令要B-PROJECT发展YourTube，理想做法自然是请教精于此道的Ultras。

programme.title: 魔都女行粤
programme.desc: 发掘「魔都」隐世美食，来到地道面馆，娅溦、糖妹按照网上排名点菜，蛤蜊猪肝拌面、茄盒、腰花辣肉汤面，果真名不虚传。光顾传闻「怪脾气」师傅蛋糕店、古早味冰糕与人气脆香鲜肉月饼，风味小吃滋味连连。主持们被「古董花园」复古氛围吸引，优雅地浅尝美式松饼与造型蛋糕。接着游逛老上海欧式风格小区，先打卡再觅食。入黑，味蕾试试新口味，主打越南粉的东南亚餐厅，可会是两位主持杯茶？酒吧内的鸡尾酒名字趣怪，越夜越精彩！

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粤
programme.desc: 肥妈提到羊肉有滋阴、补肾的功效，是进补的上佳食材。「印度羊肉饭」用上的印度米淀粉含量较低，而且纤维丰富，适合减肥人士。阿妈另将芫荽头、黑胡椒、鱼露等，加入免治羊肉中拌匀，再做成串烧，菜式同样充满异国风味。「孜然羊架」需要先煎后焗，但腌制步骤才是重点，有何独门秘方？三道羊菜式均香浓惹味，肥妈特意准备清甜解腻的「菠萝椰花糖雪花冰」作甜品。她带6号到果栏选购菠萝，泰国、台湾与菲律宾的品种究竟有甚么分别？

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粤
programme.desc: 6号「单拖」到街市买海鲜，并发挥节目宗旨落力讲价！他买来蛋白质丰富的鲍鱼，让肥妈炮制「姜葱蚝油鲜鲍鱼」。鲍鱼裙边呈现黑色，怎样清洁？「酸菜鱼」用上以鱼头与鱼骨煮成的鱼汤，鲜上加鲜；阿妈还提醒泡椒才是辣味来源，要小心用量。蒸虾菜式以粉丝和胜瓜置底，能够吸收虾的鲜味。制作「凉拌小鲜鱿」时，阿6竟拿自己与肥妈的身形教大家分辨鱿鱼和墨鱼，当然惹得阿妈发火！另外，6号又会示范时下火热饮品奶盖茶的DIY做法。

programme.title: 少年中医说粤普
programme.desc: 节目聚焦于青年族群体验中医药文化，集结中国七所中医药的7名高校学子，在主持人和中医药名家的带领下，探寻中华医圣故里，以「盲盒路线分组体验」医圣故里的形式，了解医圣对当代中医药发展的启示。

programme.title: 约埋班Friend去旅行粤PG
programme.desc: 振朗三人跟澳洲名胜三姐妹峰打卡，某人合照时笑言其美貌无死角！路旁驶来红色跑车，只有两名幸运儿可自驾游车河，对讲机的另一端则不断传来被抛下那一位的「葡萄」话语。众主持于下午茶时间聊天，话题竟是围绕内裤「乱噏」！到达豪华住宿地，朱仔躺进浴缸中不愿起来。振朗随后躺在其身上，还哼起歌来，果真有福同享？入夜，大家把酒谈心。三人于剧集《反黑路人甲》建立友谊，谈及这剧的拍摄点滴，振朗有一幕忍笑失败仍被播出？

programme.title: 约埋班Friend去旅行粤PG
programme.desc: 众主持搭乘空中缆车睇靓景，期间更可登上车顶。振朗出发前曾许愿要和慰玲拍MV，来到大型花园，节目组让他化身「张导」，并争分夺秒完成拍摄。MV用上「反黑」剧歌<对手戏，请细心观赏个中的「三角恋」演出。走进豪华游艇来趟船屋体验，主持们边用餐边诉说家人对各自演艺路的支持。三好友盛装到海边，原来是乘坐水上飞机，振朗更于空中与悉尼歌剧院打卡。在可欣赏海滩胜景的餐厅用膳，大家倾谈结婚话题外，朱仔还会「剧透」！

programme.title: 甜心先生粤
programme.desc: 吃甜品的口味，与个人形象、性格并无直接关系，甜品达人阿古(古嘉俊) 与嘉宾温家伟(大只仔)，虽然外形特质大不相同，却原来大家同是英式下午茶的「拥趸」。有见及此，阿古特意准备了一款下午茶常见的松饼，并以新鲜水果制成大只仔最爱的蓝莓果酱，让他安坐家中也能享用精美茶点。大只仔就在制作甜品过程中发掘了不少窍门，足见他的细密心思。完成作品后，大只仔亦会分享制作心得，以及透露心目中一种与下午茶最匹配的美食。

programme.title: 新干线战士 改变世界粤日
programme.desc: 天惊讶于太晴三人相识只有两个月便能百无禁忌，太晴告诉他重点在于互相尊重的心。UNKNOWN出现，太晴三人陷入苦战，天想通后重新坐上新干线战士，更凭著准确的观察和指示，成功以战术击败敌人。

programme.title: Hands Up粤
programme.desc: 「My Little Show」的才艺表演舞台再次展开，三位女孩伴随节拍翩翩起舞，带来可爱的芭蕾表演，洋溢童真魅力。另一位女生则以古筝弹奏桂林少数民族的舞曲，优雅琴音为现场增添古典气息。随着女结他导师弹奏<幼稚园、<告别校园时，她与主持姐姐放声合唱，勾起许多美好的校园回忆，滢仴姐姐尤其难忘有同学仔不小心在课堂上放屁的趣事。

programme.title: 屁屁侦探粤日
programme.desc: 箭猪荒山在山上挖掘寻宝但一无所获，后来遇到摊档的蚯蚓妈妈，听信其占卜并带她上山。汪汪警察局接报蚯蚓妈妈被绑架，屁屁侦探亦获邀加入调查，一行人根据种种线索，上山追查蚯蚓妈妈下落。

programme.title: 樱桃小丸子粤日
programme.desc: 小丸子家里电视机故障，需要三天时间才能修好，小丸子自不用说，连姐姐也罕有地表示不满。小玉正在看一本小说，并和冬田约好看完后互相分享感想，但过程中一直有事令她分心，导致阅读进度缓慢。

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粤
programme.desc: 香港特区政府带领各个部门及单位，适时推出不同的政策措施，为本港市民、到访旅客、来自外地的投资者提供便捷服务。香港这么好，当然要多说一些让大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以轻松有趣的拍摄手法，配合陈豪、高海宁、张振朗、刘佩玥、周嘉洛、罗子溢、马国明、陈懿德、陈展鹏、刘颖旋等一众星级艺员，透过不同角色、形象，生动地表达香港的各样美好和优势。

programme.title: 潜行天下粤
programme.desc: 《潜行天下》以全球海洋为主题，采用8K超高清摄影机和水下无人机等技术建构沉浸式观影体验，跨越四大洋14国水域拍摄，记录双髻鲨、鲸鲨等海洋生物活动，探密三沙永乐龙洞等特殊地形。

programme.title: 六点半新闻报道粤
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六点半，报道本地、两岸及国际重要新闻。

programme.title: 星期日档案粤
programme.desc: 戏棚在香港已有大约150年历史，过往每逢神诞、太平清醮、盂兰胜会，一座座临时戏棚便会以竹、木搭建而成，棚内或做拜神仪式，或做「神功戏」表演。不过随著城市发展及经济转型，不少拜神仪式已经简化，部分社区在盂兰胜会期间，更会转用金属取缔竹木搭建的戏棚。面对行业式微，一群戏棚师傅如何延续传统的竹棚技艺？

programme.title: 警声百二秒 III粤
programme.desc: 「警声百二秒」系列再次归来，《警声百二秒 III》由警方代表联同众多艺员参与演出，会继续透过有趣的故事情节，介绍香港警务处更多部门的工作、更多防罪讯息，让广大市民可轻松「全方位」了解警队更多资讯。

programme.title: 东张西望粤
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报道娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: 香港欧化飞鹰活络油呈献:中年好声音4粤
programme.desc: 导师分组赛迎来最终回，台上再次举行独唱较量，三队代表分别演绎那英、张学友、张惠妹的作品。这集最低分队伍要淘汰一人之外，本轮三集累积总分最低队伍亦会有两人被淘汰，竞争越趋白热化！红队布志纶、紫队高少华、绿队张嘉铭，三位导师各自带领的学员当中，谁人即将离开《中4》舞台？此外，这集亦会诞生本辑节目的首位MVP。

programme.title: 一周星星粤
programme.desc: 黎耀祥、萧正楠、曹永廉因参演《大太监》而熟络，早前拍综艺自驾游澳洲，有何深刻点滴？除了啜核挖苦的日常外，他们亦会有浪漫一面！「你问我答」，黎诺懿向祥哥索「拎视帝」秘诀，祥哥亦妙趣示范相同对白的三种演绎。阿萧又可「恨得奖」？阿廉的腰围受黄智贤关注，主持潘盈慧拿出量尺……某人录音控诉阿萧常与阿廉通电话，又不时穿著对方衣服，莫非有不可告人之事？三位好丈夫又会如何回答「我今日有何不同」这条经典的女伴提问？

programme.title: 美食新闻周报粤
programme.desc: 星厨莫灿霖推介居酒屋，与波波享用炒墨鱼配木鱼酱油汁、高森和牛三文治配牛骨汤，令人回味无穷。北角地胆施焯日走访该区的食街，试吃吞拿鱼苹果碎蛋比高包、不同馅料的煎饺，以及台式麻酱凉面配卤水百页豆腐。Agnes再带焯日品尝新派韩式风味亚洲料理，包括配上水果特制酱汁的鱿鱼刺身、咖喱韩式炸鸡，以及绍酒醉酱油蟹，尽是不一样的味道。九龙城开业逾七十年的清真菜馆，其爆汁牛肉饼、羊肉小笼包与咖喱羊腩，皆为必试名物。

programme.title: 晚间新闻粤
programme.desc: 报道本地、两岸、国际重要新闻以及体育消息，让你洞悉各地大事及体坛动向。

programme.title: 叠影狙击#8粤PG
programme.desc: 晓晨潜入文诺的办公室放下窃听器，怎料被监控镜头拍下来了，于是将错就错，假装投靠文诺，并藉著人工岛的计划书，取得俊雄的信任。恒辉无故失踪，天齐怀疑院长谋财害命，于是潜入院长室，竟然发现大量老人的身份证…

programme.title: 东张西望粤
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报道娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: 少年中医说粤普
programme.desc: 节目聚焦于青年族群体验中医药文化，集结中国七所中医药的7名高校学子，在主持人和中医药名家的带领下，探寻中华医圣故里，以「盲盒路线分组体验」医圣故里的形式，了解医圣对当代中医药发展的启示。

programme.title: 约埋班Friend去旅行粤PG
programme.desc: 四人到清迈郊外等待看日出，并诉说相关经历。和嘉洛同往看日出许愿竟是两男？JW最有记忆的日出，是与吴业坤一起拍剧。畏高的JW鼓起勇气试玩动力滑翔伞，降落即要求拥抱互勉。登艇游河兼食船面，甚么令陈滢眼湿湿？走进市场，大家开始试吃之行，JW献出食榴梿第一次。主持们换上民族服，边品尝地道美食边欣赏民族表演。四人分组在周末市集买食物开餐，同时考验另类默契。挑战丛林间的过山车与飞索，JW能否再次战胜恐惧？

programme.title: 约埋班Friend去旅行粤PG
programme.desc: 深入清迈乡村逛小店，朱仔竟踊跃发言，拍档都配合地转为「静音模式」。朱仔更挑战JW底线要其吃蜜蜂蛋，吓得她落荒而逃！四人分享清迈之旅难忘点滴，有人讲到喊，更发觉此行绝对不容嘉洛缺席！大家还透过收到的礼物，竞猜自己的「秘密天使」……张振朗、赖慰玲接力出发，办理飞澳洲的登机手续之际，朱仔惊喜送机，却是「计中计」，他会乘坐航班的商务位同行。站在海水中央食蚝，可有特别感受？不过，振朗的熟练开蚝技术才是焦点！

programme.title: 甜心先生粤
programme.desc: 吃甜品的口味，与个人形象、性格并无直接关系，甜品达人阿古(古嘉俊) 与嘉宾温家伟(大只仔)，虽然外形特质大不相同，却原来大家同是英式下午茶的「拥趸」。有见及此，阿古特意准备了一款下午茶常见的松饼，并以新鲜水果制成大只仔最爱的蓝莓果酱，让他安坐家中也能享用精美茶点。大只仔就在制作甜品过程中发掘了不少窍门，足见他的细密心思。完成作品后，大只仔亦会分享制作心得，以及透露心目中一种与下午茶最匹配的美食。

programme.title: 魔都女行粤
programme.desc: 糖妹、娅溦变身优雅吃货，置身以老香港美学打造的点心餐厅，品尝炖老鸽汤、波龙芦笋饺、Q弹太雕蛋蒸黄鱼，黑米咸水角又有甚么惊喜滋味？两位可人儿转往别致Cafe，一件拿破仑草莓蛋糕，她们竟掀起吉士酱与奶油之争！分途发掘魔都小店，糖妹踏足潮人必到的中古风生活杂货，搜罗各式可爱造型的创意家品。另一边厢，娅溦在澳洲网红旗舰店朝圣，「悉瓜」蛋糕一试难忘。放慢脚步，二人偷得浮生光顾酒馆，糖妹还会挑战辣辣上海川菜！

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粤
programme.desc: 肥妈提到羊肉有滋阴、补肾的功效，是进补的上佳食材。「印度羊肉饭」用上的印度米淀粉含量较低，而且纤维丰富，适合减肥人士。阿妈另将芫荽头、黑胡椒、鱼露等，加入免治羊肉中拌匀，再做成串烧，菜式同样充满异国风味。「孜然羊架」需要先煎后焗，但腌制步骤才是重点，有何独门秘方？三道羊菜式均香浓惹味，肥妈特意准备清甜解腻的「菠萝椰花糖雪花冰」作甜品。她带6号到果栏选购菠萝，泰国、台湾与菲律宾的品种究竟有甚么分别？

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粤
programme.desc: 6号「单拖」到街市买海鲜，并发挥节目宗旨落力讲价！他买来蛋白质丰富的鲍鱼，让肥妈炮制「姜葱蚝油鲜鲍鱼」。鲍鱼裙边呈现黑色，怎样清洁？「酸菜鱼」用上以鱼头与鱼骨煮成的鱼汤，鲜上加鲜；阿妈还提醒泡椒才是辣味来源，要小心用量。蒸虾菜式以粉丝和胜瓜置底，能够吸收虾的鲜味。制作「凉拌小鲜鱿」时，阿6竟拿自己与肥妈的身形教大家分辨鱿鱼和墨鱼，当然惹得阿妈发火！另外，6号又会示范时下火热饮品奶盖茶的DIY做法。

programme.title: 熊猫一家人粤普
programme.desc: 各实习饲养员结束了康养区和繁育园的学习和工作，回到神树坪基地。这段时间，导师们见证了各实习生的成长过程，对他们的进步都感到满意。另一方面，为了教育园区游客关于熊猫的基础知识，实习生们举办了教育课堂。

programme.title: 豆小鸭神奇小分队(完)

programme.title: 小小动物历险记
programme.desc: 动物园可真是个疯狂的地方！原本不在同一片大陆的动物，如今都在一起共同生活。但对一群好朋友来说，动物园就是他们的家！这里有活泼好动的大象拉拉、聪明的鳄鱼沃比、害羞的白虎咪噗、俏皮的水獭可可子，还有勇敢的鸽子狄尔，快来和我们一起认识这群朋友吧！

programme.title: 绅士与小姐
programme.desc: 【韩国收视破38%韩版《真善美》重拾幸福时光】《我唯一的守护者》编剧金始庆最新家庭剧新作，与爸爸、继母一同生活的直率女孩朴丹丹，因继兄继母闯祸被诈骗，使得原本不富裕的家庭更加困苦，面对爸爸的偏坦对待，朴丹丹愤而离家，因缘际会下来到有钱人家担任住宿教师，陪伴失去母亲的三个孩子，而他们的爸爸便是高冷霸道总裁李英国，在妻子早逝后，英国的内心渐渐封闭，与孩子间也产生隔阂，好在天真浪漫的朴丹丹出现，加上孩子们的凑合，幸福将再次降临。

programme.title: 家宴
programme.desc: 【离家追梦，还是回家团圆？冯家菜北漂生存战】冯家菜是北京颇具名气的淮扬菜馆，女强人大米凭借一身拼劲，将小馆打造成金字招牌，却因妹夫欠债，陷入食品安全风波，生意一落千丈。为救餐馆，她请出退休父亲参赛，夺得全国冠军，却招来资本大鳄周路的觊觎。亲情与利益交织，事业与爱情碰撞，兄妹间信任破裂，冯家菜面临生死存亡。当大米病倒，家庭崩解，弟弟豆子终于悔悟，全家携手重建家业。当扬州炒饭再次上桌，家的味道，未曾改变。

programme.title: 生活家
programme.desc: 【金马演员携手演出破产母女生存记】少见的审计职场剧，乐观正向，带给人心激励。从小在拮据家庭成长的邱冬娜，在课业工作上总是特别勤奋，希望透过自己的努力让母亲过上好生活。毕业后，因缘际会下进入了前辈顾飞开的审计稽核公司，面对孤僻但能力强的主管顾飞，邱冬娜虽然头痛但绝不认输！运用从母亲身上学到的智慧，还有艰困生活带给她的精打细算体质，邱冬娜总能屡出奇招化解艰难任务。曾有心理创伤的主管顾飞，也在邱冬娜的陪伴下，两人亦师亦友,相互扶持鼓励，逐渐治愈伤口，成为彼此的灵魂伴侣。

programme.title: 两个女人的房间
programme.desc: 【惨遭闺蜜心机暗算朴恩惠由饭店继承人沦为女仆】在瑞士留学归来后，晴彩充满自信地踏入了蒙娜丽莎饭店，端庄秀丽的外表和聪颖的头脑，让她很快成为了饭店的副社长兼继承人。与同饭店的总经理志燮之间的恋情，更是让她的生活充满了甜蜜和期待。一场车祸意外将掀起腥风血雨，当晴彩以为自己撞死了熙秀的养父时，内心充满了恐惧与内疚感，在晴彩的坚持下，熙秀搬进了她的家，开始了新的生活。从那时起，晴彩心爱的人和她的一切都逐渐被熙秀所夺走，包括饭店的地位和财富，晴彩更是从继承人沦为女仆，为了夺回曾经的一切，晴彩将对熙秀展开复仇。

programme.desc: 【宋茜邂逅周渝民，事业失意返乡传承青花瓷再现风华！！】北漂少女陈小满努力工作、省吃俭用为求入股家族瓷器事业，却以失败收场，毅然决然回景德镇专心学习瓷器工艺。陈小满工作的上司柯岩则在投资上遭遇前所未有的失利，辗转来到景德镇。处于低潮的两人在互相治愈中重新找回站起来的力量，事业重新起步，爱情也开始萌芽。

programme.title: 绅士与小姐
programme.desc: 【韩国收视破38%韩版《真善美》重拾幸福时光】《我唯一的守护者》编剧金始庆最新家庭剧新作，与爸爸、继母一同生活的直率女孩朴丹丹，因继兄继母闯祸被诈骗，使得原本不富裕的家庭更加困苦，面对爸爸的偏坦对待，朴丹丹愤而离家，因缘际会下来到有钱人家担任住宿教师，陪伴失去母亲的三个孩子，而他们的爸爸便是高冷霸道总裁李英国，在妻子早逝后，英国的内心渐渐封闭，与孩子间也产生隔阂，好在天真浪漫的朴丹丹出现，加上孩子们的凑合，幸福将再次降临。

programme.title: 家宴
programme.desc: 【离家追梦，还是回家团圆？冯家菜北漂生存战】冯家菜是北京颇具名气的淮扬菜馆，女强人大米凭借一身拼劲，将小馆打造成金字招牌，却因妹夫欠债，陷入食品安全风波，生意一落千丈。为救餐馆，她请出退休父亲参赛，夺得全国冠军，却招来资本大鳄周路的觊觎。亲情与利益交织，事业与爱情碰撞，兄妹间信任破裂，冯家菜面临生死存亡。当大米病倒，家庭崩解，弟弟豆子终于悔悟，全家携手重建家业。当扬州炒饭再次上桌，家的味道，未曾改变。

programme.title: 生活家
programme.desc: 【金马演员携手演出破产母女生存记】少见的审计职场剧，乐观正向，带给人心激励。从小在拮据家庭成长的邱冬娜，在课业工作上总是特别勤奋，希望透过自己的努力让母亲过上好生活。毕业后，因缘际会下进入了前辈顾飞开的审计稽核公司，面对孤僻但能力强的主管顾飞，邱冬娜虽然头痛但绝不认输！运用从母亲身上学到的智慧，还有艰困生活带给她的精打细算体质，邱冬娜总能屡出奇招化解艰难任务。曾有心理创伤的主管顾飞，也在邱冬娜的陪伴下，两人亦师亦友,相互扶持鼓励，逐渐治愈伤口，成为彼此的灵魂伴侣。

programme.title: 两个女人的房间
programme.desc: 【惨遭闺蜜心机暗算朴恩惠由饭店继承人沦为女仆】在瑞士留学归来后，晴彩充满自信地踏入了蒙娜丽莎饭店，端庄秀丽的外表和聪颖的头脑，让她很快成为了饭店的副社长兼继承人。与同饭店的总经理志燮之间的恋情，更是让她的生活充满了甜蜜和期待。一场车祸意外将掀起腥风血雨，当晴彩以为自己撞死了熙秀的养父时，内心充满了恐惧与内疚感，在晴彩的坚持下，熙秀搬进了她的家，开始了新的生活。从那时起，晴彩心爱的人和她的一切都逐渐被熙秀所夺走，包括饭店的地位和财富，晴彩更是从继承人沦为女仆，为了夺回曾经的一切，晴彩将对熙秀展开复仇。

programme.title: 家宴
programme.desc: 【离家追梦，还是回家团圆？冯家菜北漂生存战】冯家菜是北京颇具名气的淮扬菜馆，女强人大米凭借一身拼劲，将小馆打造成金字招牌，却因妹夫欠债，陷入食品安全风波，生意一落千丈。为救餐馆，她请出退休父亲参赛，夺得全国冠军，却招来资本大鳄周路的觊觎。亲情与利益交织，事业与爱情碰撞，兄妹间信任破裂，冯家菜面临生死存亡。当大米病倒，家庭崩解，弟弟豆子终于悔悟，全家携手重建家业。当扬州炒饭再次上桌，家的味道，未曾改变。

programme.title: 绅士与小姐
programme.desc: 【韩国收视破38%韩版《真善美》重拾幸福时光】《我唯一的守护者》编剧金始庆最新家庭剧新作，与爸爸、继母一同生活的直率女孩朴丹丹，因继兄继母闯祸被诈骗，使得原本不富裕的家庭更加困苦，面对爸爸的偏坦对待，朴丹丹愤而离家，因缘际会下来到有钱人家担任住宿教师，陪伴失去母亲的三个孩子，而他们的爸爸便是高冷霸道总裁李英国，在妻子早逝后，英国的内心渐渐封闭，与孩子间也产生隔阂，好在天真浪漫的朴丹丹出现，加上孩子们的凑合，幸福将再次降临。

programme.title: 我的野蛮王妃
programme.desc: 【神级经典韩剧，尹恩惠、朱智勋、金桢勋、宋智孝再现现代宫廷指腹为婚！！】申采静原本只是一名平凡无奇的高中学生，得知爷爷的遗嘱中，她与皇太子李信有婚约在身。因家中债务的原因，在无可奈何的情况完婚。待在皇室的申采静对宫内生活十分反弹，此时海归回来的皇位第二继承者李律及李信前女友闵孝琳的存在，展开错综复杂的故事。

programme.title: 另一种蓝
programme.desc: 【宋茜邂逅周渝民，事业失意返乡传承青花瓷再现风华！！】北漂少女陈小满努力工作、省吃俭用为求入股家族瓷器事业，却以失败收场，毅然决然回景德镇专心学习瓷器工艺。陈小满工作的上司柯岩则在投资上遭遇前所未有的失利，辗转来到景德镇。处于低潮的两人在互相治愈中重新找回站起来的力量，事业重新起步，爱情也开始萌芽。

programme.title: 装腔启示录
programme.desc: 初级律师唐影在上海红圈律所工作，意外结识了合作方许子诠。虽然二人暗生情愫，却始终没有勇气直面真实的情感。两人历经多次事件，最终在唐影的帮助下，许子诠驱散了多年阴影，敢于直面情感不再逃避，而唐影也在许子诠的信任和陪伴下，接受了自己最真实的一面。

programme.title: 坏记忆橡皮擦(完)
programme.desc: 【金在中携陈世娫出演新剧《坏记忆橡皮擦》回归电视剧！！】曾是被看好的网球之星李君，在负伤之后丧失了自尊心，认为自己从人生的主角变成配角。遇上脑研究中心的医生景珠妍，使用了记忆橡皮擦抹去了过去记忆，重生为运动经纪人，而景珠妍也意外成了他的初恋。因被篡改的记忆开始的罗曼史，在得知真相后其结局将会如何呢？

programme.title: 六龙飞天
programme.desc: 李成桂为了正式的投身政治启程去往开京，李芳远也跟随着父亲去了开京。来到开京的李芳远看到了置百姓死活于不顾只为自己填饱肚子的权文势族，无法抑制住自己内心的愤怒。原本就对于李成桂的政界出仕很警惕的李仁谦将李成桂邀请到自己家里并举办了宴会，在宴会上李仁谦给他看了以他背叛了曾经像兄弟一样的赵小生为题材的街头剧。在宴会结束后李成桂为了让李仁谦保守自己背叛赵末生的秘密，向李仁谦低下了头，李芳远目击到了这一幕。

programme.title: 珠玉在侧(完)
programme.desc: 【不务正业公子雯珺阴错阳差纳ㄚ环玉荐师徐璐！！】个性古灵精怪的单单单，一心想成为荐玉师却苦无机会，只能帮姐姐单双双卖些假玉，一次交易过程中无意得罪了富家玩绔公子裴沛，彼此留下很差的印象。又因突发危机单单单走投无路入府成为ㄚ环，府邸主人意外是裴沛，单单单也在调笑皆非中与裴沛逐渐相知相惜。

programme.title: 少年时代
programme.desc: 【电影《原本以为只是手机掉了》任时完，大反派变小可怜少年，勇往直前成为校园新老大！！】出生忠清南道的瘦小懦弱高中生张秉泰，以「在学校不挨打」为最大目标。某天因父亲意外的关系，连夜逃到隔壁村，转学至扶余农高竟摇身一变成为学校老大，亲身体验强者生存的热血故事。

programme.desc: There's a blackout in Car City! Troy selects the most ingenious truck to reconnect the cables: Chuck the Cherry Picker!

programme.desc: A lost container sends Troy into investigation mode. Who and where did it come from? He's very helpful and can transform!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - The Babies' trip to the Moon
programme.desc: The Babies are fascinated by the moon! Troy selects the most cosmic truck to help them get there: Rocky the Rocket!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - QUACK-QUACK - SUPERJUMP! ROOKIE AND THE FROG
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting by a pond when he suddenly sees eyes staring at him from the water. Thinking of his friend the crocodile, he first keeps a safe distance, but then realizes that it is a cool frog that jumps out of the water and performs some awesome tricks. Rookie watches and tries to copy, and it doesn’t take too long to master such leaps, the frog being an excellent teacher. And when the frog finally falls, Rookie is fast enough to catch it and save it from harm.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FLY, ROOKIE FLY! ROOKIE AND THE BIRD
programme.desc: Rookie is enjoying a sunny day when he spots a playful little bird drawing circles and shapes in the sky. Inspired to fly, Rookie climbs a tall tree to jump - but after a split second, the only way is down! Quickly, Rookie activates his parachute and lands safely. Although the bird is bursting with laughter, Rookie doesn‘t give u,p and with the help of a giant propeller, he manages to impress his new little friend.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MOOOO WHO? ROOKIE AND THE BLIND COW
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cow’s nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - PICTURE THIS! ROOKIE AND THE CAMERA
programme.desc: Rookie stumbles upon a device, picks it up, and as he goes to examine it, it flashes, and an instant picture comes out. Rookie is thrilled and immediately starts taking pictures of his entire surroundings from all sides and in all sorts of positions. Finally, he has a great idea: In his amazing new photo salon set up in a tent, photo artist Rookie will soon be waiting for all his friends to take wonderful portraits of them!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BOOKS ARE MAGIC! ROOKIE AND THE LIBRARY
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. He picks up the first book, but gets frightened when the smiling shark on the cover turns into a ravenous biter after only one page. He chooses another book with a clown’s face and laughs at the funny pictures inside, then one about astronauts and the moon, and another with beautiful landscapes, before he finds an empty, completely white book that gives him a whole new idea.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - DANCE WITH YOUR FRIENDS – ROOKIE THE DJ
programme.desc: On his hike, Rookie discovers a strange, shiny globe hanging from a tree. He gently taps it, and the ball immediately begins to spin, reflecting the light beautifully in all directions: A disco ball! Just behind i, the Rookie finds a DJ booth and soon the music starts and the party begins! Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MY SAND IS MY CASTLE! ROOKIE AND THE CRAB
programme.desc: Rookie enjoys a beautiful day by the sea, playing in the warm sand. He starts to build a sandcastle, which soon gets bigger and bigger soon and notices a crab, which is interested in his building and starts to explore it like his own house. There is a new idea! He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FRIENDS IN THE SKY, FRIENDS FLYING HIGH? ROOKIE AND THE CLOUDS
programme.desc: What could be better than a meadow of flowers on a beautiful day? Rookie is enjoying the sun and the beautiful blue sky, watching the clouds pass by - but wait! What‘s that? One of the clouds turns, and suddenly its shape reminds him of one of his friends! And who is that again? What a fun game to play! Rookie continues to search for clouds that remind him of his friends and their adventures together.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - The castle of Robins
programme.desc: Since the lens fails to be recovered, Dr. No wants to make another, but he needs robins to make it. So he attacks Rubidia, a region filled with different precious stones. But Oxin the king of Rubidia makes Dr. No his prisoner. And locked him in the castle where Chip is also locked, as Oxin also makes them prisoners to make them work as slaves in his mines. Dr. No try to make Chip to give him back the lens, but Chip denies. Later, the two manage to escape from the castle and Dr. No chases Chip with his craft. But the boy gets the scientist falls into a trap and also helps free the slaves of Rubidia.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - The harmonica trap
programme.desc: Chip and his friends create a zone with formations resembling musical instruments and make sounds harmonious. Suddenly, they become trapped within a rectangle of quartz crystals that vibrate when they form a sonic trap. A musician atom who has caught them, seeks members to assemble an orchestra. The antimatters are near and Chip asked the musician to prepare the trap to retain them and escape. The musician agrees and the antimatters are prisoners of the musician that makes them hear the terrible sound of his compositions.

programme.title: First Wives - EP2
programme.desc: Rancangan Diyana dan Michelle terbantut apabila mereka ditangkap semasa rompakan dan terpaksa menambah penculikan ke dalam senarai jenayah mereka.

programme.title: First Wives - EP3
programme.desc: Apabila Toa Seng memperoleh kelebihan yang tidak dijangka ke atas Diyana dan Michelle, dia menarik mereka lebih jauh ke dalam jaringan pakatan berbahaya yang menguji persahabatan, mereka.

programme.title: First Wives - EP4
programme.desc: Diyana dan Michelle terperangkap dalam perang geng dengan nyawa mereka di hujung tanduk, sementara siasatan Inspektor Shahlen mengenai kehilangan Satya mengaitkan Diyana sebagai suspek utama.

programme.title: Konti Karat - EP1

programme.title: Bintang Minggu Ini - EP1

programme.title: Stan Can (S1) - Carnival
programme.desc: Stanley, Sophie and Benjamin make up a new game, 'Dino-Pirates'. This is such a good game, they use it as inspiration for Stanley's carnival float.

programme.title: Number 1 Newton Avenue (S1) - Cupboard Chaos
programme.desc: A series exploring maths in everyday scenarios. With catchy songs and fun animation.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran (S3) - It's Time to Go Camping
programme.desc: JoJo's excited to go on her first camping trip with Gran Gran, Cousin Lexi and Uncle Tyrell. It'll be JoJo's first time sleeping outside, and there's lots to find out about camping.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Perfect
programme.desc: For her Father's Day card, Bluey sets out to draw a picture of herself and her father together. While recalling her favourite memories of playing with Bandit, Bluey struggles with the idea that her drawing must be perfect. Chilli tries to convince Bluey that perfection isn't easy, or absolutely necessary.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Explorers
programme.desc: While waiting to be picked up from school, Jack plays at being a sailor trying to find his way back home to Australia. Meanwhile, Jack's Dad has got lost on route to collect him.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Phones
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo want to play restaurants with Grandad, but it's a little different than he's used to... he's going to need an app to order the food!

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Yoga Badge
programme.desc: The squirrels have arrived and they're all a little bit hyped up with bundles of energy. Things are starting to get a bit frantic, and Duggee needs to calm them all down. Fortunately, he has his Yoga Badge.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The River Badge
programme.desc: Duggee has a package that needs delivering right at the other end of the river, and a long way from the clubhouse. It looks like the squirrels are going to have a day out on the boat. Good job Duggee has his River badge!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Stick Time
programme.desc: How many siblings does Norrie have? What's Duggee's favourite badge? What does everyone do on Fridays? Squirrel Club has the answers!

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - The Sphinx, Egypt
programme.desc: Glitch and the Grimbots are on holiday in Egypt where the Grimbots bury the Great Sphinx in sand, leaving only its head showing.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits (S1) - Corn
programme.desc: Live from the Roots &amp; Fruits theatre, it's Corn singing an A-maiz-ing Counting Song about his remarkably organised kernel rows.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits (S1) - Orange
programme.desc: Live from the Roots &amp; Fruits theatre, it's the daring Orange attempting to cross the stage on a tightrope, if she manages to ignore any distractions.

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - The Great Book Rescue
programme.desc: Evil Pea takes all the books from the Supermarket. Supertato, Chilli and Carrot try to rescue all the books by using acrobatic skills they learnt from their favourite circus book.

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - Hiccup Havoc
programme.desc: Supertato gets hiccups while Evil Pea is firing jam at Tato Tower. Supertato harnesses the power of his hiccups to save Tato Tower from Evil Pea's jam attack.

programme.title: Teletubbies (S1) - Close the Gate
programme.desc: The Teletubbies accidentally leave the Tiddlytubbies' gate open and some of them escape into Home Dome. The Teletubbies must find them all and then close the gate.

programme.title: Yakka Dee (S2) - Cloud
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say 'cloud' and we go on a whirlwind word adventure! We explore rain clouds, snow clouds, funny clouds and someone even dresses up as a cloud!

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO (S3) - The Great Okido Challenge
programme.desc: Messy wants to run further, but he keeps getting out of breath. Will he be able to take on the Great OKIDO Challenge and race to the finish line?

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops (S1) - Mojo Mail
programme.desc: Mojo Swoptops and best buddy Bo love to help their friends in the little town of Swoppiton. With a swop of Mojo's top and Bo's brilliant plans, they make an unstoppable team!

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Pizza Girls
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo make mud pizzas and deliver them to the grown-ups, but their pedal car's wheel keeps falling off.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Rain
programme.desc: When a heavy summer rain thunders over the Heeler home, Bluey is determined to dam the water in the front yard, while Mum tries to stop her constantly tracking mud into the house.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S5) - The Why Badge
programme.desc: Why do my feet hurt?', Tag asks Duggee. While Duggee has a think, he tells them 'why' is a great question, and the Squirrels are quick to follow up.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S5) - The Mime Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is encouraging the Squirrels to come outside by gesturing through the window. They don't understand what he's doing and think it's funny. When he comes inside, he explains that he was miming.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - What's Hot?
programme.desc: Billy and the Sillies introduce a visit to chicken A&amp;E, the Squirrels build a bug house, Norrie has her chance to shine, and the Penguins give facts about what's hot and what's not.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - I'm Hungry
programme.desc: King Tiger and the Jelly wonder what Duggee has planned for today. Tag wants a snack, Enid has a musical cheese chase, and Norrie has a haircut.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - Go Jet Academy: Global Gameshow
programme.desc: It's the Go Jetters as you've never seen them before as they take part in a disco dazzling around the world gameshow!

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Calypso
programme.desc: At school, Bluey and her friends enjoy various games. Teacher Calypso keeps her charges on track with a wise word and a song... all except the mysterious Pretzel.

programme.title: Bluey (S2) - Tickle Crabs
programme.desc: When Dad brings a pair of tenacious tickle crabs home from the beach, nowhere in the house is safe! His only hope of escaping their tickles is with help from his true love.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Onesies
programme.desc: When mum's sister Brandy comes over for a visit, she brings the kids onesies as a present, which has an unexpected effect on Bingo.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Tradies
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo hide under the house and spy on two mysterious tradies working in the backyard, wondering what they're up to.

programme.title: Andy's Aquatic Adventures (S1) - Andy and the Galapagos Sea Lions
programme.desc: Andy heads to the Galapagos Islands to see how sea lions deal with annoying flies.

programme.title: Playtime Towers (S1) - Star
programme.desc: Bella and Lift are visited by a shining star and set off to explore the floors of Playtime Towers. The first stop is Sketch in Boxtropolis - what will she be making today?

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S4) - The Wish Badge
programme.desc: Whilst helping Duggee clean up, the Squirrels come across an old lamp. Duggee explains that many years ago, when rubbed, it could grant three magical wishes.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S4) - The Size Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels learn about atoms, molecules and cells to help understand sizing when they try to sort a line-up of things from smallest to biggest.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S4) - The Getting Ready Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are getting ready for the same woodland adventure, but their mornings all look slightly different.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - Bonneville Salt Flats, USA
programme.desc: Xuli and Glitch go head to head as they try to beat the Go Jet Academy land speed record.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - The Matterhorn, Italy and Switzerland
programme.desc: Glitch gets into a mountain of trouble as the Go Jetters attempt to climb the Matterhorn.

programme.desc: Sonny returns to Sodor to try to be a really useful engine again but some of the other trains aren't willing to give him a second chance.

programme.desc: Music Lady needs Sarah &amp; Duck's help to return a music-loving stowaway back to the Cloud Tower.

programme.desc: The Teletubbies accidentally leave the Tiddlytubbies' gate open and some of them escape into Home Dome. The Teletubbies must find them all and then close the gate.

programme.title: Whose Baby is in the Classroom?
programme.desc: Chen, a male teacher in an all girls' high school, is stuck with a baby that isn't his and must take care of it. As he lives on the school grounds, the baby is a source of constant distraction and worry! Luckily, his class warms to the baby and helps him take care of it while he works his charm on Li Ching, an uptight teacher in the same school.

programme.title: The Swordmates
programme.desc: Li asks his swordmate Wang to protect his family while he is away, but Wang rapes his wife and even has his convoy attacked. Li escaped but fears his daughter is still in danger, so he asks the nephew of his master to help protect her...

programme.title: Black Magic 2
programme.desc: Doctor Sing is puzzled by the strange symptoms of his patients and asks his friend for help. The sickness is apparently caused by a black magic that is casted by a wicked man Kong. Kong covets the beauty of Sing's wife and casts an evil love spell on her, while threatening to kill Sing at the same time. Can Sing save his wife and his patients?

programme.title: The Twelve Gold Medallions
programme.desc: This was one of top three films of 1970 and winner of "Outstanding Drama" at the 9th Golden Horse Awards. The evil minister uses twelve golden medallions to summon war hero Yueh Fei back from the frontline and execute him. A group of wandering warriors, led by Yueh Hua and Chin Ping, try to stop the medallion couriers.

programme.title: The Enchanting Ghost
programme.desc: It is love beyond the grave, as a young scholar and his beautiful lover are torn apart forever by his dastardly uncle and his friend, who drive the girl to commit suicide... but with death comes revenge for the enchanting ghost. A spooky yet heart-wrenching tale...

programme.title: The Flying Guillotine
programme.desc: Ma Teng is an assassin of the 'Flying Guillotine Squad', a group of killers commissioned by the Emperor Yung. When Ma starts to question the morality of his missions, he finds himself becoming a fugitive hunted by his former comrades.

programme.title: Hex Vs Witchcraft
programme.desc: A compulsive gambler with bad luck owes money to a violent gangster boss and trades his wife as down payment, causing her to leave him. As he decides to kill himself, a mysterious old man offers him a proposal to marry the ghost of his dead daughter in exchange for cash and an expensive apartment.

programme.title: Have Sword Will Travel
programme.desc: When the head of a manor loses his kung fu skills, he enlists his nephew and fiancee to escort gold to the capital. Along the way, they encounter a mysterious swordsman and join forces with him to stop bandits from stealing the gold.

programme.title: Fast Fingers
programme.desc: After his release from prison, Uncle Bill returns to make a fortune with his past thieving partners. They continue to prey on the unsuspecting public, but are closely watched by the upright police chief, who happens to be the boyfriend of one of Uncle Bill's nieces!

programme.title: Disciples Of Shaolin
programme.desc: Yi is a skilled disciple of the Hong Quan style kung fu who work in a textile mill recommended by his senior, Han. Han warns Yi not to show off his martial arts skill so as to avoid getting into trouble. However, Yi does not listen and eventually gets dangerously involved in the conflict between two opposing textile mills.

programme.title: The Purple Shell
programme.desc: Hui and Ha are stuck in their unhappy marriages and are attracted to each other when they meet at a party. In one of their beach strolls, Ha picks up a purple shell and gives it to Hui as a memento. When Hui's husband finds out about them, he hurts Hui and causes her to become seriously ill, while also blackmails Ha. How will this love story end?

programme.title: Temple Of The Red Lotus
programme.desc: A young guy Wu, heads off to the Dragon Valley to meet his childhood friend Lian Chu, who was promised to be his bride. When he arrives, he finds out that the family of his bride may not be an entirely honest bunch of people. Wu wishes to take Lian Chu with him, so he has no choice but to fight against her family...

programme.title: The Singing Escort
programme.desc: Betty Ting plays Susan, a young woman hiding from her father by being a nightclub singer in Japan. Pop singer Chao Ke-jen (Lin Chong) gets permission from his boss to visit Japan, with the condition that he finds the boss's daughter. Boy finds girl, boy falls in love. But will the father approve?

programme.title: The Anonymous Heroes
programme.desc: In this action comedy, two young men join a rebel group after the Chinese Revolution of 1911 and accidentally become patriotic heroes. Assisted by a warlord's daughter, they successfully help the rebels steal weapons from the warlord.

programme.title: The 5 Billion Dollar Legacy
programme.desc: A crippled billionaire mails a letter to each of his long-lost daughters inviting them to go to Japan, in the hope that he will find a worthy heir to inherit his vast fortune. The sisters finally meet abroad the plane to Japan, and one of them is taken with a man who is going to investigate the death of his lawyer uncle in a mysterious hit-and-run.

programme.title: The 5 Billion Dollar Legacy
programme.desc: A crippled billionaire mails a letter to each of his long-lost daughters inviting them to go to Japan, in the hope that he will find a worthy heir to inherit his vast fortune. The sisters finally meet abroad the plane to Japan, and one of them is taken with a man who is going to investigate the death of his lawyer uncle in a mysterious hit-and-run.

programme.title: Mission Impossible
programme.desc: A sword master's daughter is pursued and poisoned by an evil master when bringing back the stolen Golden Sword to the palace. She dies on the run and returns as a spirit to take revenge by killing the evil master, and soon vanishes after returning the sword to the emperor.

programme.title: Facets Of Love
programme.desc: Set in the Ming Dynasty, the story revolves around a brothel and the girls who work there. The film begins by following the life of a girl from a poor family, who is sold by her mother to the brothel. While she is the most beautiful of the girls and attracts many clients, the girl hopes to escape this sad way of life one day.

programme.title: The Happiest Moment
programme.desc: This erotic comedy anthology features three stories about an old man who dies from an overdose of virility pills, a cop who goes on the run after extorting money from a hooker, and a barber's apprentice who encounters a lively corpse in a night vigil. Through playing all these characters, Michael Hui proves himself as a genius of Hong Kong comedy.

programme.title: Boxer Rebellion
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager Cixi believes the Boxers' claim that they have developed a kung fu that makes them impervious to weapons, thus declaring war against the alliances of eight foreign nations. The lack of weapons and good leadership in the Ching government allows the Eight Nation Alliances to take down Beijing.

programme.title: Descendant of the Sun
programme.desc: Shi Sheng is adopted by an old carpenter and grows up to possess extraordinary superpowers. One day, he unexpectedly discovers his identity as the son of the solar deity and learns that his power will be lost during solar eclipse. When an evil spirit appears and wreaks havoc, Shi Sheng must beat him in an ultimate duel to save the world.

programme.title: Two Con Men
programme.desc: Two Con Men is a wonderfully twisted, pseudo-romantic comedy in the vein of "Robin Hood" meets "The Sting". Starring Liang Tien as Clever Chan and Chang Ying (who's done over 400 films) as Tricky Ching, it's the age-old competition between a rookie con artist versus the ultimate, experienced flimflam man. It's a game Chen cannot afford to lose, because people's lives - including his own, hang in the balance of good versus evil.

programme.title: Full Moon Scimitar
programme.desc: Swordsman Ding fought against many swordsmen and won, so he took his first defeat badly and wanted to commit suicide. It is then that he meets the granddaughter of a mystic Sect leader and falls in love. When they want to get married, the Sect leader presents Ding with the "Full Moon Scimitar", on the condition that he will never leave the sect.

programme.title: The Bride Napping
programme.desc: A rich girl Yue Ying, together with her maid Chun Lan, encounter a poor scholar Bian Ji at a fete. Chun Lan realizes Yue Ying is in love with him, but mixes his identity with a bandit due to an old servant's confusion, threatening the couple's union. After a series of complications, misunderstandings and mismatches, Chun Lan finally saves the day.

programme.title: The 36th Chamber of Shaolin
programme.desc: Gordon Liu plays an anti-Manchu rebel who escapes to the Shaolin Temple and learns what it truly takes to become a martial arts master by challenging the 35 Shaolin Kung Fu chambers, eventually creating the 36th chamber himself.

programme.title: Till the End of Time
programme.desc: This is Jenny Hu's stunning debut as a struggling singer who tries to keep her career and marriage intact. This movie also includes seven memorable hit songs.

programme.title: Vengeance is a Golden Blade
programme.desc: Convoy Master Li's wife has an affair with his rival Long, who plans to steal Li's Golden Blade and kill him as well as his young daughter. Li and his daughter manage to escape and the latter grows up to be a skilled swordswoman who vows to avenge her mother's death - a lie told by Li. The truth is revealed when she sees her mother alive by chance.

programme.title: Pale Passion
programme.desc: Fa is an obsessive man who loves his wife Ah Hsia but is easily jealous and abuses her. When she leaves him one day, Fa hooks up with another woman, Hsing. A deadly triangle develops when Fa runs into Ah Hsia again and decides to win her back...

programme.title: One Way Only
programme.desc: Danny is a motorbike workshop owner, once was a renowned motorcycle racer, but were seriously injured in an illegal race. Mai, student of Danny, wins a race in Macau under Danny's help. However, because of money and honour, Mai joins illegal races. After knowing this, Li persuades Mai to stop illegal races, but Mai seems cannot find his way out...

programme.title: One Way Only
programme.desc: Danny is a motorbike workshop owner, once was a renowned motorcycle racer, but were seriously injured in an illegal race. Mai, student of Danny, wins a race in Macau under Danny's help. However, because of money and honour, Mai joins illegal races. After knowing this, Li persuades Mai to stop illegal races, but Mai seems cannot find his way out...

programme.title: Sex, Love and Hate
programme.desc: This masterpiece spins three interconnected tales about Hong Kong society's differing views on love and what women want from love. Follow a trio of Hong Kong women as they explore relationships and fulfil their hopes of finding true love.

programme.title: Marco Polo
programme.desc: Mongolian emperor Kublai Khan is being assassinated while meeting with the Italian explorer Marco Polo. Marco Polo is appointed to lead the troops for the emperor to wipe out the anti-Mongol rebels. Yet, he is touched by these rebels who are resisting the Mongolian invasion of their homeland. Will Marco Polo stay loyal to the emperor?

programme.title: The Grand Substitution
programme.desc: In this Opera epic, a loyal Imperial Court servant gives up his own newborn son to save the prince from an evil official.

programme.title: The Fake Ghost Catchers
programme.desc: Huan Zhu's ghost seeks help from "Fake Ghost Catchers" Bao Tuo and Zhou Peng, after a jealous suitor's ghost seeks vengeance by murdering her and now targeting her sister. Together with actor Wu Shun Chao who possesses a supernatural talent, they unite to protect Huan Zhu's sister from both mortal and spectral threats.

programme.title: The Last Tempest
programme.desc: This sequel to The Empress Dowager continues the tale of Emperor Guangxu and Empress Dowager Cixi. Despite Guangxu's enthronement, his ability to rule effectively is overshadowed by the ever-present power of Cixi. When his attempts to reform the Imperial system are thwarted by the Empress Dowager, Guangxu attempts to curb her power.

programme.title: Heroes Shed No Tears
programme.desc: Kao Chien Fei is a young swordsman who wields a special sword with a teardrop marked on its blade. He is charged with averting an impending crisis in the martial arts world, but the villain, Zhou Tung Lai, wishes to become the ruler in the martial arts world, and launches a scheme to pit the various heroes against one another.

programme.title: Sons Of Good Earth
programme.desc: This is an epic tale set during the time of the Sino-Japanese war. A painter Yu saves a young girl, Lotus, who is being sold to a brothel. They fall in love, get married and settled in to a peaceful life. However, their life is soon shattered by the Japanese invasion and the brutal regime that follows...

programme.title: Five Shaolin Masters
programme.desc: The Qing court plots to kill all Shaolin disciples by burning down Shaolin Temple. This sudden fire killed almost everyone except for five disciples. To take revenge on the Qing court, the five of them train hard in different fighting styles to become "The Five Shaolin Masters".

programme.title: Lovers Blades
programme.desc: The Lovers Blades, a pair of invincible weapons, are to be delivered to the Qing Emperor. However, they accidentally fell into the hands of Xiao Zhong Hui and Yuan Guan Nan, so Imperial Chief Zhuo Tian Xiong hunts them down for the blades. As the battle begins, the secret of the blades are also revealed.

programme.title: Shaolin Martial Arts
programme.desc: The Qing government assigns fighters to destroy Shaolin Temple and kill all the disciples, but two of them successfully escaped. They train under different masters and learn the Wing Chun and Hung Quan styles respectively, finally killing the fighters and taking revenge for the death of their fellow disciples.

programme.title: Tropicana Interlude
programme.desc: Ping and Su are lovers who operate a travel agency specializing in Southeast Asian holidays. Tung, a school mistress, and her students join a guided tour lead by Ping. During the trip, a spoiled kid Li is attracted to Ping but Su thinks Ping has fallen for Tung and leaves. How will Ping deal with the situation and ends up happily back with Su?

programme.title: The Proud Youth
programme.desc: Ling Hu Chong, a Huashan clan's disciple, is assigned to find the successor to the score "The Proud One". Ling identifies Ying for the score but finds out that she is the daughter of the evil clan's leader. At the same time, he is unwittingly dragged into an epic power struggle between clans, with complicated allegiances and perplexing moralities.

programme.title: The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This side-splitting comedy sees naive Ah Niu headed to Hong Kong, where he is repeatedly exploited and taken advantage of, and eventually finds himself arrested and imprisoned! Can he survive difficult times and finally overcome adversity?

programme.title: Casino Tycoon II
programme.desc: This is a sequel to "Casino Tycoon". 20 years after Benny Ho established his casino empire in Macau, his former partner becomes envious and plots to bring him down. At the same time, a young man working for Benny is the son of his ex-lover, and is also out to take revenge on him. Ho however, is not about to take things lying down...

programme.title: Painted Face
programme.desc: Scholar Wang Huai Qing sells paintings to save his ailing wife. He is attacked by a bird demon along the way but is rescued by Fox demon Xiao Rong. To elude the pursuit, Wang brings Xiao Rong home, sparking a love triangle and at the same time, unfolding an impending love between human and demon.

programme.title: Punish Evil
programme.desc: A shipment of newly issued currency is robbed by three armed robbers, prompting Detective Chang to investigate. Following new leads, he successfully takes down one of the robbers. Meanwhile, the other two plot to rob a gold factory amidst the chaos. With meticulous planning, Chang thwarts their scheme and brings them to justice.

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: Never Leave
programme.desc: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yue's house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror; her father is peeping at night; and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

programme.title: Operation Bangkok
programme.desc: Military veteran Wu and undercover cop Ming rescue hostages on an island near Bangkok. Just as the mission is completed and they prepare to leave, Wu discovers his daughter has also been captured. Determined to save her, he stays with Ming to fight the thugs and rescue her.

programme.title: Jealousy
programme.desc: Model Min is admitted to a hospital, but mysteriously falls to her death at night. Rumour has it that the hospital is haunted. Subsequently, Min's photographer begins receiving eerie phone calls, the writer loses consciousness in a bizarre car accident, and her friend mysteriously disappears...

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto. Who is the real King of Thieves?

programme.title: Love Is Love
programme.desc: Shui and Tai are lovers who grew up together in a village but move to the city as Tai's father disapproves of their relationship. Tai secretly works in a nightclub to help finance Shui to get the job of a salesman. When Shui is promoted for his good work and finds himself progressing in his career, he begins to feel distant from Tai...

programme.title: Fist of Legend
programme.desc: When Chen Zhen studies in Japan, he finds several Chinese students missing and accidentally uncovers the Black Dragon Society's conspiracy. A new drug is invented to boost bodies of the Japanese troops in war and the Chinese students are used in their experiments. Chen Zhen vows to take down the evil society and destroy their secret laboratory.

programme.title: The Sorcerer & The White Snake
programme.desc: In this action fantasy movie based on the Chinese legend of the White Snake, a young herbalist falls in love with a thousand-year-old white snake disguised as a woman. When the white snake's true identity is revealed, a sorcerer goes to battle believing that in doing so, he is restoring balance and order between man and the supernatural.

programme.title: How to Pick Girls Up !
programme.desc: Xin, a helpless loser in love, calls in to a radio show hosted by DJ Tsang to ask desperately for help. A self-proclaimed love expert, Tsang takes it upon himself to make sure Xin meets girls and leads him on a series of absurd excursions into the wild and dangerous world of modern love.

programme.title: Kowloon Walled City
programme.desc: Neng was a street fighter in Northeast China but decides to start a new life in Hong Kong's Kowloon Walled City. Unfortunately, he is implicated in the fights and conspiracies among the triad forces. When his good friend is hunted down by the triad, Neng must team up with the residents of Kowloon Walled City to fight back and save his friend.

programme.title: Women
programme.desc: Bo Yi's husband is having an affair, so Bo Yi divorces him and joins the "Happy Spinsters Club" set up by her friends. However, she soon finds out that she does not enjoy being single and while sorting out her thoughts, her repentant husband begs her forgiveness. She must now decide on what she truly wants.

programme.title: Iceman
programme.desc: Falsely accused of murder, Ming Dynasty Imperial Guard Ying is pursued by his three sworn brothers until a fierce battle leaves all four entombed in ice. Four hundred years later, they awaken in modern Hong Kong, where they must reignite their ancient feud in a world they can barely recognize.

programme.title: Face to Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. At Tamotsu's funeral, Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man and that is only the beginning of an evil downfall for him...

programme.title: Face to Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. At Tamotsu's funeral, Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man and that is only the beginning of an evil downfall for him...

programme.title: The Grandmaster
programme.desc: Directed by the acclaimed filmmaker Wong Kar Wai, this epic action feature begins in Foshan when Ip Man, the martial arts master from the south, takes up a challenge by ageing northern master Gong Yu Tian. Ip Man wins the fight, but is then defeated by Gong Yu Tian's daughter Gong Er, with whom he forms an emotional bond...

programme.title: The Revenge
programme.desc: Ruo Wei returns to her childhood home with two best friends, and reunites with her cousin who has always lived there. While they plan to enjoy their trip, they are constantly haunted by paranormal events, ending up in a terrifying experience with unexpected outcome.

programme.title: Hidden Heroine
programme.desc: A drug cartel is entrenched in the Dong Zhou area. Mei Jing of the Thunderbolt Women's Commando Unit, leads her team to attack the drug base, but they are being ambushed and the identity of Mei's father as an undercover is exposed. After a fierce battle, Mei and her team manage to successfully defeat the drug cartel and rescue her father.

programme.title: The Monkey is Back
programme.desc: The savior of the people, Stone Monkey, has given hope to a desperate little girl which he promises to realize. Years later, Stone Monkey is defeated in a battle with the three-eyed God of War, causing him to lose his power and falls into the mortal world. Can he fulfill his promise to the girl and stop the God of Wood from destroying earth?

programme.title: Lost Memories
programme.desc: As a young mother grapples with her daughter's mysterious disappearance, a series of eerie events unfold. These events could be linked to the vengeful ghosts of a tragic accident that happened 20 years ago...

programme.title: VR Fighter
programme.desc: Bodyguard Long Wei has post‐traumatic stress disorder after his wife's death. One day, he encounters Amy who works for a VR technology firm and is invited for a new product test. After the test, Long Wei becomes the firm's VR fighter and dons the newly invented armour. However, as mysterious armed men break in, a fierce battle has just begun...

programme.title: Turns We Take
programme.desc: A spicy hot pot restaurant in Northeast China serves different types of customers every day. Amongst them are a sweet young couple, two wayward young men and a taxi driver. Despite being complete strangers to each other, their lives are intertwined by a traffic accident...

programme.title: The Fate of Reunion
programme.desc: Thousands of years ago, Green Snake gained enlightenment under the guidance of Dao Qing and gradually falls for him. However, her devotion to Dao Qing caused him to reincarnate and go through the pains of death. Since then, she sets out to search for the many reincarnations of Dao Qing over hundreds of years to help him reverse the situation...

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its "Cop Shop Babes" as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat - can they resolve the case?

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his brother arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Befriending a powerful mobster Tam, Ma is given his nightclub when he saves Tam's life. Ma's fortune rises but he must overcome the corruption and violence to survive.

programme.title: Maoshan Heavenly Master
programme.desc: Prisoner Chi flees away under Master Zhang's custody, causing the latter to be expelled from his clan. On his way to find Chi, Master Zhang arrives at a place where many people vanish for no reason. He soon discovers that it is Chi who captures them in his training to become a serpent demon. The war between human and demon has just begun!

programme.title: The Mighty Peking Man
programme.desc: King Kong comes to Hong Kong in THE MIGTHY PEKING MAN, a uniquely Shaw Brothers spin on the ageless theme of beauty and the beast. The beast, seven stories high and hailing from the Himalayas, makes his way to the jungles of India in the wake of a violent earthquake. The beauty is Russia starlet Evelyne Kraft, a sexy blonde Tarzanette who is the Mighty Peking Man's best friend.

programme.title: Destiny's Champion
programme.desc: An aging fighter relives the mistakes of his violent past through a poor and streetwise kid, who severely injures his nemesis during a battle to win a girl's heart.

programme.title: Fight Back to School
programme.desc: SDU officer Chow Sing Sing goes undercover at a school to locate a missing gun. With his partner Tat, he successfully recovers the weapon, only to stumble upon a munitions smuggling ring. In retaliation, the smugglers storm the school and take students hostage, forcing Sing to risk everything to save them.

programme.title: Unmatchable Match
programme.desc: Undercover cop Lang is assigned to befriend former triad boss Fei in order to investigate a diamond heist masterminded by the ruthless gangster Big Mad. When the deal goes awry and the diamonds end up in Fei's possession, Big Mad comes after them with a vengeance, forcing Lang and Fei to join forces as an unlikely bond begins to form between them.

programme.title: Unmatchable Match
programme.desc: Undercover cop Lang is assigned to befriend former triad boss Fei in order to investigate a diamond heist masterminded by the ruthless gangster Big Mad. When the deal goes awry and the diamonds end up in Fei's possession, Big Mad comes after them with a vengeance, forcing Lang and Fei to join forces as an unlikely bond begins to form between them.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Comparing to the director's previous Hex. This time, however, the stakes are even higher and the gruesome goings-on even more memorable. It all starts when a noble police detective starts investigating a child killer's claims of an evil spell, then it doesn't let up until the final, bloated, maggot-ridden cadaver falls.

programme.title: Cruel War
programme.desc: To combat the greenhouse effect, scientist Yan Xin attempts to plant newly developed super rubber seeds on a remote island, hoping to transform it into a thriving new land. Yan Xin's ex-husband decides to accompany her on this perilous journey. As conflicts arise, they encounter the local drug cartel, and a fatal battle is about to begin.

programme.title: Mahjong Heroes
programme.desc: A hero helps a young student deflect a cunning and malicious gambling tycoon who is out to take over the student's family business over a game of mahjong.

programme.title: Zombie Island
programme.desc: Jeff, a big fan of zombies, goes to a deserted and mysterious island with his friends hoping to seek out exciting adventures. What started as an adventure turns out to be a horrifying journey as they get trapped on the island and are attacked by the zombies! Their lives are in danger when they fail to fight back, and the game has only just begun!

programme.title: The Gangster, the Cop, the Devil
programme.desc: The movie is adapted from real events. Detective Lin sets up a special unit to arrest the motorbike robber and the crime syndicate behind the thefts in Foshan. In the process, his pregnant wife is hit by a motorbike robber, leading him to uncover their revenge plan...

programme.title: Paper Man
programme.desc: As the police investigate a gang murder case, another mysterious paper man murder happens, and the suspects get killed one by one. Continuing to track the clues of the case, the police finally unveil a hidden secret and tragedy over two generations.

programme.title: Justice, My Foot!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays Sung, a lawyer who uses any means necessary to help his wealthy clients escape the law. Sung retires to the countryside when urged by his wife, but when Mrs Sung encounters a woman whose husband's death has been covered up by corrupted officials, Sung returns to the court for justice to be served.

programme.title: Fight Back to School
programme.desc: SDU officer Chow Sing Sing goes undercover at a school to locate a missing gun. With his partner Tat, he successfully recovers the weapon, only to stumble upon a munitions smuggling ring. In retaliation, the smugglers storm the school and take students hostage, forcing Sing to risk everything to save them.

programme.title: Iceman the Time Traveler
programme.desc: In this sequel, the four imperial guards are defrosted and reanimated in modern Hong Kong. Driven by a single goal to obtain the Golden Wheel of Time and right the wrongs of the past, Ying embarks on a perilous quest, unaware that every step draws him deeper into a deadly trap.

programme.title: Look Out, Officer!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow is a delight in this supernatural action comedy, where a murdered police officer returns from beyond the grave to persuade a rookie cop into avenging his death.

programme.title: Painted Faces
programme.desc: This is based on the real-life story of Master Yu Jim Yuen who strives to run his academy in the 1960s, even as the opera culture is declining. Three young men, Sammo Hung, Jackie Chan and Yuen Biao, are determined to train under Master Yu and undergo extremely tough training before they become three of Hong Kong's biggest stars

programme.title: Wusong VS Ximenqing
programme.desc: Wu Song finds out about his sister-in-law's affair with a rich man, Ximen Qing. Qing sets Song up and have him exiled for a year, during which his hapless brother is murdered and cremated. When Song finally returns home, he takes the case to court but the judge brushes it aside and closes it abruptly. Can Song finally avenge his brother's death?

programme.title: The Flying Mr. B
programme.desc: Mr. Shi, a secondary PE teacher, accidentally takes a "super pill" invented by the science teacher and gains superpower, turning into Mr. B. He uses his superpower to help the school sports team win the championship and prevent crimes. When the triad is made aware of Mr. B's superpower, they try to gain the super pill for nefarious purposes.

programme.title: Hong Kong Hong Kong
programme.desc: After moving to Hong Kong, illegal immigrant Mang has no choice but to live in cramped quarters with male migrants who abuse her. In order to attain Hong Kong residency and a better life, she agrees to marry a lonely old carpenter. After her marriage, Mang crosses paths again with her ex-lover, and the two develop a passionate affair...

programme.title: Seeding Of A Ghost
programme.desc: It's an erotic gore-fest starring Kao Fei who seeks vengeance against his wife's rapists and killers by soliciting the help of a demented magician. In return, he endures copulating dead bodies as his enemies perish in blood spurting and body exploding glory. It's one of Hong Kong goriest films ever made.

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia S2 - Kanjigaargh
programme.desc: Blinky, Toby and Claire make a dangerous trade with the Janus Order while Gunmar sets Jim up in a battle to the death

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Ghastly Danger of the Ghost Dentist
programme.desc: The pressure's on Harold and George to tell the scariest campfire story ever. Perhaps their tale of an ill-fated frontier dentist will do the trick.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Confounding Concoction of the Crooked Combotato
programme.desc: A fierce game of plot potato takes an unexpected twist when Melvin unleashes one of his most fiendish -- and carb-loaded -- creations yet.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Ludicrous Lunacy of the Loopy Laserlightmare
programme.desc: Despite being terrible at the job, Krupp wants to be the camp director again next summer. That's something Harold and George simply cannot abide.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Biscuits Rising
programme.desc: Lured into an empty hotel where a baby has supposedly gone missing, the team is trapped by Crispin Biscuits, a chaotic British schoolboy baby who’s been hired to wreck Boss and Tina’s lives. Crispin puts the new company’s loyalty to a test in a series of fiendish puzzling mind games, all with the threat of constant balloon popping (horrible for baby ears!)

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Moon Shot
programme.desc: Our team’s startup company and their rivals at Baby Corp get in a "Space Race", competing to see who can make the cutest kiddie-pretend "moon landing" for a baby - a spectacle sure to bring in a bounty of Baby Love. With both companies pouring their resources into a simulated space take off, tempers and sabotage are running hot, and the scrappy little startup is in danger of getting crushed by their big business competitor.

programme.title: Voltron: Legendary Defender S1 - The Depths
programme.desc: Lance and Hunk crash on a water planet and must rescue a mind-controlled mermaid civilization

programme.title: Voltron: Legendary Defender S1 - Shiro's Escape
programme.desc: The team sets off to a new planet where they hope to find information on Shiro's past

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free S1 - Lucky And The Pie P.I.
programme.desc: Mysteries collide when horse thieves strike Miradero at the same time as a pie thief strikes the church bake sale while the adults try to keep the horse thieves at bay Lucky is determined to find out who stole the pies.

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales S1 - Why Lion Roars
programme.desc: You see there was a time when Lion had lost his roar. Crocodile was snapping at all the animals in the Waterhole and Lion opened his big mouth but nothing came out! Tiny Flea tells Lion that if he dares to enter the Great Cave of Tinga Tinga then maybe he will find his roar. Lion plucks up courage and goes into the Great Cave. He roars with all his might, but a bigger roar comes back! Lion stands strong. He roars again and an even bigger roar comes back.

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales S1 - Why Zebra Has Stripes
programme.desc: Zebra was once very easy to spot in Tinga Tinga as he was bright white all over. This very annoying as all he wanted was to be left alone to munch on yummy grass and get fat. One day, Eagle arrives at the Watering Hole with a new pair of sharp talons saying that she found them in the Great Cave. The animals excitedly rush to find something for themselves. Zebra accompanies Tortoise and the Monkeys into the Cave where they discover the last remaining item; a plain black coat.

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Funny Business
programme.desc: Big Chris receives a mysterious parcel… the cars are intrigued to find out what is in it. Strange and silly things start happening at the workshop, could it have anything to do with Big Chris' package?

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Nick Solves The Case
programme.desc: PC Pete has been summonsed to get to the bottom of some missing fuel. But where's Nick? And who can solve the case?

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Simply The Best
